faqs.question: How can I join a group buying pool?
faqs.answer: You can open the 'Active Pools' tab in our app and add the desired items to your cart. Once fellow shopkeepers participate and meet the target pool volume, the bulk order is placed at factory wholesale rates.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity for wholesale prices?
faqs.answer: Since you pool your orders with other business retailers, there is zero minimum order quantity. You can purchase even 1 unit at bulk wholesale rate.

faqs.question: How long does order delivery take?
faqs.answer: As soon as the group pool target is locked, your inventory is dispatched and delivered directly to your shop doorstep within 24 to 48 business hours.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my pooled order?
faqs.answer: You can cancel free of charge at any time before the pool locks. Once the pool is locked and confirmed with suppliers, cancellations are not permitted.

faqs.question: How do I verify I am getting genuine wholesale pricing?
faqs.answer: Our app transparently displays both the prevailing open retail market price and our pooled bulk wholesale price, so you can calculate your exact store profit margin before ordering.

faqs.question: Which cities and areas do you currently serve?
faqs.answer: We currently serve major commercial hubs across Pakistan. You can enter your shop postal code or commercial area in the app to check immediate delivery coverage.

faqs.question: What happens if a product goes out of stock in wholesale market?
faqs.answer: You will receive an instant notification, and any advance payment made will be 100% credited back to your DigiBuzz wallet or bank account immediately.

faqs.question: How do I track customer credit and payments in Digital Khata?
faqs.answer: Navigate to the 'Digital Khata' tab in the app, click 'Add Customer', and easily log daily credit debit entries, receipts, and outstanding dues.

faqs.question: Is my business ledger and customer credit data secure?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely. All your ledger and customer transactions are end-to-end encrypted and automatically backed up to secure cloud storage daily.

faqs.question: Can I send automated payment reminder bills to customers?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can send automated, courteous payment reminder notices with ledger statements directly to customer WhatsApp and SMS numbers with one click.

faqs.question: Do you offer credit or installment financing for shopkeepers?
faqs.answer: Initially wholesale purchases are on cash terms. However, active retailers who regularly trade through our group buying network become eligible for credit limits and revolving financing.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted for bulk orders?
faqs.answer: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD), Online Bank Transfers (IBFT), and mobile business wallets including EasyPaisa and JazzCash.

faqs.question: Are there any hidden membership or service charges?
faqs.answer: No, Digital Khata and DigiBuzz membership are 100% free forever. For group deliveries, only a transparent, nominal delivery fee is shown before final checkout.

faqs.question: What is the return policy for damaged or defective items?
faqs.answer: If you receive any damaged or defective stock, simply submit photo proof via 'Help & Claims' in the app within 24 hours of delivery. We provide a full replacement or instant refund.

faqs.question: How quickly are refunds processed?
faqs.answer: Approved refunds are credited to your DigiBuzz wallet instantly or transferred to your bank account within 2 to 3 business working days.

faqs.question: How can I register my shop on the DigiBuzz B2B Network?
faqs.answer: Download the DigiBuzz mobile app, enter your phone number, business shop name, and commercial address. Your merchant account activates immediately.

faqs.question: Can I record ledger transactions offline without internet?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can record entries offline. The moment your phone re-connects to the internet, all offline entries synchronize seamlessly to the cloud.

faqs.question: What should I do if the app is slow or facing technical errors?
faqs.answer: Please ensure you have the latest app version installed or clear the app cache. You can also contact our technical helpline directly for instant support.

faqs.question: What are your operating hours for deliveries and customer support?
faqs.answer: Customer support is active from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM (Monday to Saturday). Warehouse deliveries operate from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily.

faqs.question: Can I speak directly with a human representative or manager?
faqs.answer: Certainly, I am transferring your call to our dedicated human customer support manager. Please stay on the line.
